subject: SAME clause
notes: cite.py --check 12.4.6.4.3 "The files specified in a given SAME clause need not all have the same organization or access" -> OK SR4 (a permission). BindIoControl links files by their record anchors with no organization/access test, and nothing else screens it. Probe gr2_mixed: `SAME RECORD AREA FOR F1 F2 F3` over ORGANIZATION SEQUENTIAL (PIC X(4)), RELATIVE ACCESS SEQUENTIAL (group X(2)+X(6)) and LINE SEQUENTIAL (PIC X(10)) compiles at 2023 and runs correctly (see GR-12.4.6.4.4-2); fmt_all_ok mixes SD and FD files in one clause. No spec-derived test mixes organizations. [registrar 14a — editions as adjudicated: 85, 2002, 2014, 2023 (the SAME clause is base I-O-CONTROL language in every edition; no Annex E change entry names it)]
